_comment: Rush Track monetization config. The game ships in MOCK mode (no add-ons present): ads are simulated 2.2s cards and IAP are simulated 1.8s flows, so the full player loop works on any device before keys exist. To go live: (1) add your AdMob app id + unit ids below, (2) drop the Godot AdMob add-on into res://addons/godot-plugin-admob, (3) drop the IAP add-on into res://addons/godot-plugin-iap, (4) create the Play Billing products with the exact ids below. The engine auto-detects the add-ons at boot and switches to the real backends with zero code changes.
